description: Soy un MBA en Inteligencia Artificial y Ciencia de Datos. Elegí "Adaptando las granjas con datos de la NASA" porque quiero ayudar a nuestros agricultores a tener herramientas reales para tomar mejores decisiones frente al clima y sus cultivos. Buscamos personas con conocimiento en agricultura, clima, cultivos y diseño, para construir una solución con impacto genuino en el campo. Equipo: Raíces Orbitales 🌱🛰️
summary:
The solution uses NASA data to advise the agricultural sector on which crops are best suited to specific land conditions. while minimizing the use of agrochemicals and provides recommendations for conserving biodiversity. It supports farmers throughout every stage of the cultivation process and incorporates the economic cycle of production costs. If a disease is detected, the application allows for the identification of the potential pest or pathogen via a photograph. The AI tool "Claude" was used for the application's code development. Additionally, the app’s photo based inquiry feature and invoice reading function utilize an AI model with vision capabilities. Conversely, climate analysis (based on NASA data) and crop suitability scoring do not rely on AI; instead, they operate according to a set of fixed rules.
Data from the NASA POWER project specifically the Agroclimatology community was utilized, providing both daily and climatological datasets. Parameters include temperature, corrected precipitation, relative humidity, solar and photosynthetically active radiation, and wind speed. This data informs historical charts, monthly climate profiles, 60 day projections, and crop suitability scores. The system incorporates data from NASA POWER as well as other complementary sources, including API documentation, FAO ECOCROP, and Costa Rica’s MAG  and INTA.
details:
Siembra Clara is our solution for the "Field Shift: Adapting Farms with NASA Data"

challenge.

THE PROBLEM

Climate change and limited access to information affect the people who grow our

daily food. The excessive use of agrochemicals nationwide also harms human health

and the environment, and small farmers often face these challenges alone, without

timely guidance.

WHAT IT DOES

Siembra Clara turns NASA POWER climate data (rainfall, temperature, humidity,

radiation, and wind) into simple planting advice. Farmers select their canton or

district and the month, and the app shows the best crops to plant, each with a

score, risk level, and expected profit. It also provides a weekly care plan with

low-impact pest control, 18 months of climate history plus a 60-day forecast,

cost tracking to calculate real profit, and a photo-based consultation feature

for quick diagnosis.

BENEFITS

Helps farmers choose what to plant with more confidence, reduces climate-related

losses, lowers agrochemical use, and makes expected profit clear from the start.

EXPECTED IMPACT

Helping small-scale farmers in Costa Rica adapt to climate change, reduce costs,

and protect the environment.

TOOLS USED

HTML/CSS/JavaScript, Python, FastAPI, Vercel, the NASA POWER API, and Claude (AI).

CREATIVITY

Siembra Clara turns satellite data into everyday farming decisions, and recommends

shade trees that naturally reduce pest pressure.

FACTORS CONSIDERED

The app was designed considering that many users have limited digital experience

and use it on mobile phones in the field. It prioritizes simple language,

accessibility, consideration for Indigenous communities, and environmental care.

Team: Raíces Orbitales
